---
title: 'How to create dynamic plots'
---

Static figures, as shown in the [Quarto Markdown Guide](/doc/Examples/example1.qmd), work well for fixed illustrations[cite: 10]. For interactive scientific plots requiring zoomable 2D/3D canvases, analytical curve evaluation, tabular data overlays, LaTeX math labels, or animated parameter sweeps, this template provides a custom `dynamic-plots` filter powered by Plotly[cite: 10].

# Defining Curves and Plotting a Canvas

Unlike tables, dynamic plots separate **curve definitions** from the **plot canvas**[cite: 10]. Definition blocks (`::: {.plot-function id="..."}` or `::: {.plot-file id="..."}`) register mathematical expressions or data series without rendering anything on their own; a `::: {.dynamic-plot}` block then renders one or more registered IDs onto a single interactive canvas[cite: 10]:

```markdown
::: {.plot-function id="wave-sin"}
expr: sin(2 * x) * exp(-0.2 * x)
label: $e^{-0.2x}\sin(2x)$
xrange: [0, 8]
:::

::: {.plot-function id="circle-eq"}
expr: (x - 4)^2 + y^2 = 0.64
label: $(x - 4)^2 + y^2 = 0.8^2$
xrange: [0, 8]
yrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
color: crimson
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: wave-sin, circle-eq
xlabel: $x$
ylabel: $y(x)$
yrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
height: 400
:::
```

::: {.plot-function id="wave-sin"}
expr: sin(2 * x) * exp(-0.2 * x)
label: $e^{-0.2x}\sin(2x)$
xrange: [0, 8]
:::

::: {.plot-function id="circle-eq"}
expr: (x - 4)^2 + y^2 = 0.64
label: $(x - 4)^2 + y^2 = 0.8^2$
xrange: [0, 8]
yrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
color: crimson
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: wave-sin, circle-eq
xlabel: $x$
ylabel: $y(x)$
yrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
height: 400
:::

# Block Configuration

All plot blocks are configured using `key: value` pairs inside fenced divs[cite: 10]. Every `.plot-function` and `.plot-file` block requires a unique `id` attribute so it can be referenced in `curves:`[cite: 10].

## Canvas Options (`.dynamic-plot`)

The `::: {.dynamic-plot}` block controls axes, layout, and interactive widgets[cite: 10]:

- `curves`: Comma-separated list of curve IDs to display together (required)[cite: 10]. All curves must share the same dimensionality (all 2D or all 3D), with at most one parameter-sweep curve per canvas[cite: 10].
- `xlabel`, `ylabel`, `zlabel`: Axis titles, supporting inline LaTeX math (`$ ... $`, `\( ... \)`)[cite: 10].
- `xscale`, `yscale`, `zscale`: Axis scaling (`linear` or `log`, default `linear`)[cite: 10].
- `xrange`, `yrange`, `zrange`: Explicit axis bounds formatted as `[min, max]` (must be strictly positive for `log` axes)[cite: 10].
- `height`: Canvas height in pixels (integer $\ge 200$, default `480`)[cite: 10].
- `legend`: Shows or hides the collapsible right-hand legend sidebar with per-curve visibility checkboxes (`true` or `false`, default `true`)[cite: 10].
- `play`: Adds a Play/Pause animation toggle beside the parameter readout (`true` or `false`, default `false`, valid only when `curves` includes a sweep)[cite: 10].

## Analytical Functions (`.plot-function`)

Use `::: {.plot-function id="..."}` to evaluate explicit functions or implicit equations directly in the browser[cite: 10]:

- `expr`: Mathematical expression (required)[cite: 10]. Expressions without `=` define explicit curves `y = f(x)` or surfaces `z = f(x, y)`; equations with `=` define implicit 2D contours `f(x, y) = g(x, y)` or 3D isosurfaces `f(x, y, z) = g(x, y, z)`[cite: 10]. Supports `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `^`, implicit multiplication (`2x`), constants (`pi`, `e`), and standard functions (`sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `sinh`, `cosh`, `tanh`, `exp`, `log`, `ln`, `log10`, `log2`, `sqrt`, `abs`, `sign`, `floor`, `ceil`, `min`, `max`)[cite: 10]. Explicit 2D functions automatically resample on zoom and pan[cite: 10].
- `label`: Legend entry, supporting inline LaTeX math (default: the block's `id`)[cite: 10].
- `color`: Trace or surface CSS color, such as `#1f77b4`, `crimson`, or `rgb(31, 119, 180)` (default: automatic colorway)[cite: 10].
- `xrange`, `yrange`, `zrange`: Sampling domain `[min, max]` along each axis (default: canvas range, co-plotted file extent, or `[-10, 10]`)[cite: 10].
- `points`: Sample resolution per axis, integer $\ge 2$ (defaults: `100` for 2D explicit, `60` for 2D implicit and 3D explicit, `25` per axis for 3D implicit)[cite: 10].
- `mode`: Drawing style for explicit 2D curves (`lines`, `markers`, or `lines+markers`, default `lines`)[cite: 10].
- `smooth`: Enables spline interpolation between sample points (`true` or `false`, default `true`)[cite: 10].

## Data Files and Logarithmic Axes (`.plot-file`)

Use `::: {.plot-file id="..."}` to plot numeric columns from `.csv`, `.tsv`, or whitespace-delimited text files (blank lines and lines starting with `#`, `%`, or `//` are ignored automatically)[cite: 10]:

- `src`: Path to the input data file (required)[cite: 10].
- `x`, `y`, `z`: Column expressions using **0-based column tokens** (`c0`, `c1`, `c2`, …) and any supported math operators or functions (`x` and `y` required; `z` enables 3D scatter/line traces)[cite: 10].
- `skip`: Number of leading non-comment header rows to ignore, integer $\ge 0$ (default `0`)[cite: 10].
- `label`, `color`: Legend title (with inline LaTeX support) and CSS trace color[cite: 10].
- `mode`: Drawing style (`lines`, `markers`, or `lines+markers`, default `lines+markers`)[cite: 10].
- `smooth`: Enables spline interpolation (`true` or `false`, default `false`)[cite: 10].

File traces can be overlaid directly with analytical `.plot-function` models and plotted on logarithmic axes (`yscale: log` or `xscale: log`, which automatically filters non-positive values when auto-scaling)[cite: 10]:

```markdown
::: {.plot-file id="energy-data"}
src: data/example-plot-damped.csv
skip: 1
x: c0
y: c2
label: Measured energy
mode: markers
color: #2ca02c
:::

::: {.plot-function id="energy-fit"}
expr: exp(-0.70 * x)
label: $E_0 e^{-0.70t}$
color: #1f77b4
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: energy-data, energy-fit
xlabel: Time $t$ [s]
ylabel: Energy $E(t)$ [J]
yscale: log
height: 400
:::
```

::: {.plot-file id="energy-data"}
src: data/example-plot-damped.csv
skip: 1
x: c0
y: c2
label: Measured energy
mode: markers
color: #2ca02c
:::

::: {.plot-function id="energy-fit"}
expr: exp(-0.70 * x)
label: $E_0 e^{-0.70t}$
color: #1f77b4
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: energy-data, energy-fit
xlabel: Time $t$ [s]
ylabel: Energy $E(t)$ [J]
yscale: log
height: 400
:::

## Parameter Sweeps and 3D Scenes

Two specialized capabilities support multi-snapshot datasets and 3D visualization[cite: 10]:

- **Parameter sweeps (`.plot-file` + `play: true`):** When a file stores snapshots across multiple columns, set `y` to a column range (`c1..c7`) or list (`c1, c3, c5, c7`) and supply matching `param` values (`0..3` or `0.0, 0.5, 1.0, ...`)[cite: 10]. Optional `param-label` formats the live parameter readout (with inline LaTeX math), `transform` applies a formula to each sweep value `y` (such as `y^2`), and `play: true` on `.dynamic-plot` adds a Play/Pause button[cite: 10].

```markdown
::: {.plot-file id="wave-sweep"}
src: data/example-plot-sweep.csv
x: c0
y: c1..c7
param: 0..3
param-label: $t$ [s]
label: Wave amplitude
smooth: true
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: wave-sweep
xlabel: $x$ [m]
ylabel: $\psi(x, t)$
play: true
height: 440
:::
```

::: {.plot-file id="wave-sweep"}
src: data/example-plot-sweep.csv
x: c0
y: c1..c7
param: 0..3
param-label: $t$ [s]
label: Wave amplitude
smooth: true
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: wave-sweep
xlabel: $x$ [m]
ylabel: $\psi(x, t)$
play: true
height: 440
:::

- **3D surfaces, implicit volumes, and trajectories:** Combining 3D `.plot-function` definitions (explicit `z = f(x, y)` surfaces or implicit `=` isosurfaces) with 3D `.plot-file` traces (`z:` specified) renders an interactive WebGL 3D scene[cite: 10]:

```markdown
::: {.plot-function id="saddle-surface"}
expr: 0.25 * (x^2 - y^2)
label: $z = \frac{1}{4}(x^2 - y^2)$
xrange: [-1.5, 1.5]
yrange: [-1.5, 1.5]
points: 40
:::

::: {.plot-function id="unit-sphere"}
expr: x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 1
label: $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 1$
xrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
yrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
zrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
points: 22
color: #2ca02c
:::

::: {.plot-file id="helix-path"}
src: data/example-plot-3d.csv
x: c0
y: c1
z: c2
label: Helix trajectory
mode: lines+markers
color: #ff7f0e
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: saddle-surface, unit-sphere, helix-path
xlabel: x
ylabel: y
zlabel: z
height: 500
:::
```

::: {.plot-function id="saddle-surface"}
expr: 0.25 * (x^2 - y^2)
label: $z = \frac{1}{4}(x^2 - y^2)$
xrange: [-1.5, 1.5]
yrange: [-1.5, 1.5]
points: 40
:::

::: {.plot-function id="unit-sphere"}
expr: x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 1
label: $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 1$
xrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
yrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
zrange: [-1.2, 1.2]
points: 22
color: #2ca02c
:::

::: {.plot-file id="helix-path"}
src: data/example-plot-3d.csv
x: c0
y: c1
z: c2
label: Helix trajectory
mode: lines+markers
color: #ff7f0e
:::

::: {.dynamic-plot}
curves: saddle-surface, unit-sphere, helix-path
xlabel: x
ylabel: y
zlabel: z
height: 500
:::
